annotations.title: What can be filtered and grouped for a family

description:
What can be filtered, sorted and grouped for one family (properties,
    buildings, land, listings, owners, agents), with units and coverage. Call it
    before search_assets or summarise_assets when you do not know a refinement
    name; the names it lists are the `criteria` keys and `group_by` / `measures`.

    Do NOT use it to search: it returns no records. Free.
    Limits: one family per call; long lists are cut to their first 60 names.
    A call with covered=false or an upstream failure is not charged.
name: search_capabilities
title: What can be filtered and grouped for a family
